query:
Who first pushed back on committing to specific Christmas dates — citing outside obligations as the reason?

Options:
A. Adaora
B. Chidi
C. Emeka
D. Ngozi

[2] (about=Adaora, episodic, t0 @2025-02-03T14:21:00) I mean I can try to come. Depends on thesis deadlines
[3] (about=Adaora, episodic, t0 @2025-02-03T16:01:00) Fine. I'll try. No promises on exact days yet

agent_answer: C. Emeka — at 14:18 he said they’d need to see Adaeze’s schedule and would know more in a few weeks, before Adaora later cited thesis deadlines.
